cross_validation_strategy: 4-fold Group-Aware Stratified Cross-Validation (Groups = 568 sequence clusters at 70% identity)
scientific_qualification: PU model scores represent relative ranking against an uncharacterized background. They are NOT calibrated probabilities of biological activity. Absence of activity cannot be inferred from unassayed status.

evaluation_metrics.interpretation: Evaluates separation between curated positives and unassayed background; does not measure true-negative specificity against confirmed inactives.
